mapping_json.fidelity_notes: CORPSE-FUEL BLAST: Detonate Dead explodes a corpse for a percentage of THAT CORPSE'S max life as fire AoE (dossier skill_loop: '6-7.9% of corpse max life'). Two lanes engage: (1) the corpse-as-ammunition ECONOMY has a NATIVE engine lane — charge_stack_sub_shape=accumulator with accumulator_fill_trigger=on-corpse-consume (verified engine enum, resource_economy.py:142); Desecrate refills the pool. This is the kit's identity-bearing twist and it is GAPPED; docketed. Mapped as a standard fire-AoE + on-corpse-consume resource with GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade (the corpse->explosion->new-corpse clear-chain reading; a DD player chains explosions across a pack). Element: base fire->burn (probe 'burn'); Blackflame chaos-conversion is a meta item-variant noted, not the base identity. Desecrate is a shadow/necro corpse-spawn feeder.

spine.mech_note: Detonate Dead: explode a target corpse for a percentage of that corpse's maximum life as fire damage in an area. The payload scales with the VICTIM's health pool, not the caster's stats — boss-tier corpses produce massive explosions. Corpse-generation spells (Desecrate, unearth) or enemies killed by minions fuel the ammunition pipeline. Damage conversion from fire to chaos or cold is possible via support gems. Popular as a CI Occultist build (chaos bypass) or Ignite Elementalist (fire scaling). The build rhythm: generate corpses → detonate for large AoE fire blasts. Scales excellently with map monster HP pools (higher monster life = bigger explosions in red maps). Volatile Dead is a cousin skill (orbs seek and detonate corpses autonomously); DD requires manual targeting. League-start capable, scaling into red maps comfortably.
